title: How to learn good representations by prediction?
reading: The slide poses the question of how prediction tasks can yield good representations, contrasting two masking/prediction regimes. Predicting a small portion of the input may not require any high-level understanding, whereas predicting a large portion encourages the model to learn semantic features. The implication is that the difficulty or scope of the prediction target determines the quality of the learned representation.

concepts.name: Masking ratio / portion predicted
concepts.why_it_matters: Controls whether the task forces semantic understanding or trivial interpolation.
